label: Palkova
note: Srivilliputhur palkova (GI): cow milk and sugar boiled down, traditionally over tamarind-wood fires

about.text: Palkova is a sweet of Tamil Nadu made by boiling milk down with sugar to a thick grainy mass; the Srivilliputhur version, from cow milk and sugar only, has a geographical indication.

links.name: Outlook Traveller, Tamil Nadu GI products

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.label: boil down with sugar
how.text: Milk and sugar are stirred constantly over a steady fire until grainy. Figures come from news pages on the GI application, not a technical source; yield is quoted as 3.3 kg from 10 L by one page and 3.3 kg from 10 kg by another.
